01-16-1684 is January 16, 1684.  
1684 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year).  
275 days from Jan 16: Jan has 31 days, so Jan 16 → Jan 31 is 15 days (275 - 15 = 260 left).  
Feb has 29 days (leap year) → 260 - 29 = 231 left.  
March 31 → 231 - 31 = 200 left.  
April 30 → 200 - 30 = 170 left.  
May 31 → 170 - 31 = 139 left.  
June 30 → 139 - 30 = 109 left.  
July 31 → 109 - 31 = 78 left.  
August 31 → 78 - 31 = 47 left.  
September 30 → 47 - 30 = 17 left.  
October 17 → October 17, 1684.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1684-10-17
